design_philosophy: Premium, Apple/Linear/Notion/Spotify inspired. No clutter, no spreadsheets. Generous spacing, sharp accents, subtle grain textures, optical clarity glassmorphism. Left-aligned, asymmetric layouts. Beautiful enough for creators, powerful enough for publishers.

hierarchy.h1: font-['Cabinet_Grotesk'] text-5xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: font-['Cabinet_Grotesk'] text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.overline: font-['Manrope'] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500

spacing_and_layout.generous_spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for major containers. Maintain high padding inside bordered containers to avoid text collision.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strictly left-aligned asymmetry for marketing and hero text. Center alignment ONLY for standalone modals.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B (Control Room): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12, tight gaps (gap-4 to gap-6). Use h-full to stretch children.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Mode A (Tetris): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, gap-8. Mix tall and wide cards, leaving intentional negative space.

surfaces.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-zinc-950/70 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] - Use for sticky headers, nav bars, overlays.
surfaces.neumorphism_tactile: Flat bg-zinc-900 with 1px border-zinc-800, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and inner glow via border-zinc-600.
surfaces.tracing_beam: For pricing or active session recording cards, use subtle animated gradient borders.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-md font-semibold px-6 py-2 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white rounded-md px-6 py-2 transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-amber-500 text-zinc-950 hover:bg-amber-600 rounded-md font-bold px-6 py-2 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)] transition-all

components.cards: Cardless layout or sharp rectangle look. rounded-lg max, border-zinc-800/60 bg-zinc-900/40. No heavy Vercel-style drop shadows.
components.inputs_and_forms: Customize Shadcn primitives: bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500. Keep labels left-aligned and crisp.
components.timeline: Vertical left-aligned track (border-l border-zinc-800). Nodes are glass circles with glowing amber inner dots to denote verified creative history.
components.split_sheets: High-density view using Manrope for names, JetBrains Mono for percentage splits. 1px solid row borders, stark white text for active values.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements MUST have explicit hover text colors (e.g., hover:text-white). Focus states must use higher contrast ring (focus:ring-white or focus:ring-amber-500).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-out for standard interactions.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use for collaborator network display or publishing partners. Slow, smooth drift, font-mono, low contrast text (text-zinc-700).

hero_background.description: Abstract dark sound wave. Use for landing page hero background with heavy bg-zinc-950/80 overlay.

creator_portrait.description: Music producer in dark studio. Use for Creator Identity / RightPrint profile showcase.

session_image.description: Songwriter playing acoustic guitar. Use for live collaboration session visual.

media_and_images.overlay_rules: Always apply max overlay opacity bg-zinc-950/50 to images to ensure text readability (WCAG AA). Never completely obscure, ensure contrast.

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='create-session-button').

iconography.style: Clean, linear, thin stroke width (1.5px). Never use solid fill unless indicating an 'active' or 'recording' state.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the project with Dark Mode as the absolute default. Ensure the body background is #09090B (zinc-950).
2. Inject external fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) via <style> imports in index.css.
3. Build the Landing Page ('Write. Own. Protect.') prioritizing large typography, heavy negative space, and a premium editorial tech aesthetic (like Linear meets Spotify).
4. For Dashboard and Live Session flows, customize Shadcn components heavily: remove default card borders and shadows, replace with sharp 1px borders (border-zinc-800) and flat surfaces.
5. Utilize the 'LCH/Apple' inspired glassmorphism for sticky navs and dialog modals (backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-zinc-950/70, subtle top/left border highlight).
6. Include data-testid attributes on ALL buttons, links, inputs, and tab triggers for robust testing.
